current_answer: The central judgement: USDe’s risks are not captured by whether its token trades near one dollar. A managed backing portfolio, privileged issuance and redemption, and the routes through which a holder can leave must all work together. A holder can suffer a delay or forced-sale loss even without a demonstrated backing shortfall.
summary: A token can keep moving while an exit stops. The useful question is what claim you hold, who must deliver the next asset, and whether it can arrive in time.
uncertainty: The evidence supports a whole-system assessment, but does not establish current reserve coverage, complete contract security or an available par exit for every holder.
freshness_note: Documentary governance research dated 22 September 2026. Prior contract and recovery observations retain their 18 and 20 September dates. No live monitoring or current deployed-behaviour verification.
